pages.text: Altered from $(5)Impaling$(), $(4)Smothering$() greatly increases damage against fire based enemies. Maximum level is $(4)V$() and it conflicts with $(5)Impaling$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: Its usefulness matches that of Impaling, since there are only so few enemies to use it on. If a Trident with the Eruption execration is used for Nether exploration, might as well have Smothering on it too.
